notes.title: Kukui 2 Update!
notes.content: Hello everyone! We've been getting a lot of requests to have a first-person camera and so we added one! We also implemented a chapter select screen so if there is a chapter that you would like to replay, now you don't need to replay the whole game again! We hope you enjoy the new changes.
